summary: Five hikers, inadequately prepared with little protective clothing and suffering minor leg/foot injuries from snowy terrain, were stranded ~6 miles up Conundrum Creek Trail. 4 MRA field members located the group at ~3:49 AM on 4/30, supplied snowshoes, clothing, food and water, and assisted all five down the trail by ~7:40 AM.
location: Conundrum Creek Trail, ~6 mi up the trail, south of Aspen
